# Barcode fallback

`zxing-browser.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of `@zxing/browser` 0.2.1 from https://github.com/zxing-js/browser. It is loaded only when the browser does not provide a usable native `BarcodeDetector`. The bundled browser library is MIT licensed; its ZXing core dependency is Apache 2.0 licensed. The bundled ts-custom-error dependency is MIT licensed. Their license texts are included alongside the distribution.
